blocks.text: Runbook: Harbor & Oak Shopify theme deploy

This is the working cut for HBR-RB-2021-061 on September 16, 2021. Jenna Park asked for a written bound after the current path (Theme kit from ci.harbor.internal, unpublished preview) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host shop.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on publish from a laptop on Friday afternoon, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Preview theme, Dana clicks the preview, publish Tuesday or Wednesday 10:00-11:30 ET. Rollback is unpublish, not a git revert on live. I am not restating a hallway yes. publish from a laptop on Friday afternoon is out because August 26 publish at 16:44 hid the pickup rate for 22 minutes. Jenna was in the car. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at window=1.5, miss=22, friday=16:44, themes=3, files=84, minutes=9.2, weeks=2, freeze=Fri. Sibling tickets HBR-2411 and HBR-TDD-2020-021. I will not reopen publish from a laptop on Friday afternoon in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: ci.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (14): refuse on publish from a laptop on Friday afternoon, lock is Tue/Wed 10:00-11:30 ET, Dana preview, unpublish rollback. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-2411.
Publish is a window, not a Friday at 16:40 because the file saved.

What a skeptical user would try first on shop.harbor.internal: the path Jenna Park actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on theme-preview.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

I will not claim publish from a laptop on Friday afternoon is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host shop.harbor.internal.
